facts.situation: Robert and Jean Fletcher seek long-term growth, with no portfolio income required for the foreseeable future. Their agreed risk profile remains 4 (moderate). Jean has received an inheritance of around £120,000 from her late mother's estate; the funds have cleared. They want to invest it alongside their existing portfolio. Handle Jean's bereavement sensitively. The joint GIA valuation reported at the meeting was approximate. Jean also mentioned a small cash account whose balance and active status she could not recall.

actions.action: Disinvest the existing jointly held Holloway GIA, H-GIA-JF.
Use the inheritance and joint GIA proceeds to top up Robert's ISA, H-ISA-R, for the new tax year.
Use the inheritance and joint GIA proceeds to top up Jean's ISA, H-ISA-JE, for the new tax year.
Open a new jointly held investment account and invest the balance of the inheritance and joint GIA proceeds after the ISA top-ups.
